message: サリーちゃんとスウィーツ

name: Synn
message: 「How are the class location assignments coming along?」

name: Misa
message: 「You still haven't looked through them? I left them right there」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? No, they weren't there」

name: Misa
message: 「No way... huh? I'm sure they were right here」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Here you go」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh. Isn't this super neat and easy to read」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa! It's all rendered in Mincho font!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're gonna say that, you mean lettering」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Figuring something like this might happen, I made a clean copy」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm the one who made the original」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's what you call the howling of a sore loser」

name: Misa
message: 「G-grrr」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone knows you made the original, Misa-chan」

name: Misa
message: 「As long as you understand, Big Sister, that is more than enough\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Putting aside who made it」

name: Misa
message: 「I-t w-a-s m-e!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There are still five classes that haven't submitted their school subsidy applications. Let's confiscate their budgets and redirect them elsewhere. And then lower the price of the sweets buffet...」

name: Misa
message: 「More importantly, first we summon them」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you mean, 'more importantly'! Sweets are serious business!」

name: Misa
message: 「Get your mind off sweets for once!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're forgetting her name is Soba, aren't you」

name: Synn
message: 「We still have time, so why not wait a little longer」

name: Misa
message: 「Time is precious」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh... Hiss really loves throwing her weight around, huh」

name: Misa
message: 「What a terrible way to put it. Isn't it their fault for not turning them in」

name: Ria
message: 「At times like that, you just have the teacher mention it during homeroom」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, that way it won't ruffle any feathers」

name: Misa
message: 「As expected of you, Sister. How thoughtful」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though you were just saying 'summon them, summon them' a second ago」

name: Misa
message: 「Admitting one's mistakes is important too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm. A classic weathervane, I see」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san. It seems you and I need to have a thorough talk sometime」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I will politely decline. A wise person neither enters the tiger's den nor seeks its cubs」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, what's everyone doing?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ms. Tag-Along, this is a meaningful endeavor known as Student Council work, something beyond your imagination」

name: Sally
message: 「I feel like I'm being made fun of」

name: Paqy
message: 「You don't just feel like it, you are being made fun of」

name: Sally
message: 「Talking behind my back--how very angelic of you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Was that... behind your back?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It was right to her face」

name: Sally
message: 「You're just a low-ranking angel writing things down nonstop anyway」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Making clean copies of submission documents is meaningful work」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, you couldn't stand being a grunt unless you convinced yourself of that, right? Kushishi」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ngh. Besides, I am not an angel, so please remember that. Though I suppose that's asking too much of Ms. Tag-Along's memory」

name: Sally
message: 「Come on, you're totally an angel」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I am not!」
Whoa, someone who can't read the room has appeared!

name: Synn
message: 「Ahem, well. Are you interested in today's activity too, Sally?」

name: Sally
message: 「Uh-huh. I am!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why don't we give it a try together?」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about?! She's a demon, a demon!」

name: Synn
message: 「But is it actually bad if people find out what KiraFes is about?」

name: Ria
message: 「'The Earth will be destroyed.'」

name: Everyone
message: 「W-Whaaat?!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-We can't leave such a critical mission to you, Sakura-kun. Shouldn't someone more capable be president at a time like this?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even with annihilation right before their eyes, humans still struggle for power.」

name: Paqy
message: 「And then only Ria and yours truly survive as the Adam and Eve of the new world\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm kidding. I'm sorry\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「That kinda hurt my feelings!」

name: Synn
message: 「So anyway, shall we give it a try?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm, I changed my mind. Sounds like a pain, so I'll pass.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's a problem even before we get to the whole demon thing...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, doesn't it feel like everyone's losing focus?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, no. There is no need for concern.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the one I'm most worried about, Lolotte-san.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I had no focus to begin with, so there is no need to worry about losing it.」

name: Ria
message: 「You shouldn't puff your chest out and say something like that. Bad.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And with that, break time! I brought snacks.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh. Good thinking, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Leave it to me\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If the treasurer brought it... it must be soba noodles!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-N-A-C-K-S!」

name: Misa
message: 「This is hardly the time to be eating snacks」

name: Synn
message: 「A little nibble won't hurt, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「You can move your hands while you chew, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「If you say so, Big Sister\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Then I'll go make some tea」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll help as well. Oh, by the way, does anyone want black tea?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Me!」
Then I'll get the plates.

name: Synn
message: 「Does some of the cost for this come out of the Student Council budget?」

name: Ria
message: 「The tea for guests came from council funds, but everyone brought snacks from home, or got them as gifts from friends」

name: Synn
message: 「I see」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Watching everyone bustle about so eagerly just to feed me sweets is quite thrilling」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. You're helping too, Lolotte」

name: Ria
message: 「All right, everyone, the tea is ready」

name: Misa
message: 「Tea brewed by Big Sister's very own hands... Aah...\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heeey, Misa. Come back to earth」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, what's starting?」

name: Synn
message: 「Snack time」

name: Sally
message: 「Can you eat that?」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't eat snack time itself, but there'll be food」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't know what it is, but I'm starting to like snack time」

name: Synn
message: 「You should take a look before deciding」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ta-da! Sorry to keep you waiting!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Cookies, chocolate bars, candies, and sweets! Plus Mont Blanc from 'Cafe Rose Blanche'!」

name: Ria
message: 「Whoa~~\s07 Looks so good~\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Cookies aside, wasn't that cake pretty expensive? Are you sure about this...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A true Edoite never goes back on their word!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though you're a born-and-bred Ryusei local」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, isn't it a bit much...」

name: Synn
message: 「How much was it, by the way?」

name: Misa
message: 「If I recall... around 400 yen」

name: Synn
message: 「Four hu--!?」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Are you okay!?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I just got a little dizzy」

name: Misa
message: 「Toppling over chair and all--how sloppy. That's proof you're getting soft」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is delicious. I'd love to see the pastry chef's face」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, what do you think you're doing casually helping yourself, young lady!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yum-yum, chomp-chomp, nom-nom, munch-munch」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah, you little demon brat! Don't eat sweets with your bare hands!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So the Demon World has no concept of table manners. How barbaric」

name: Synn
message: 「Coming from Lolotte, who started digging in without asking...」

name: Misa
message: 「It's six of one, half a dozen of the other」

name: Sally
message: 「So good! What is this! It's sweet and delicious! I've never eaten anything like this before! Delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is it good?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, it's the best! Seriously the best! The absolute best!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is because it is free. Look, it says right there that nothing tastes better than free food」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh, really~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not 'cause it's free! It's 'cause they're *sweets*!」

name: Sally
message: 「Sweets?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「*Sweets*! The pinnacle clan of the world's confections!」

name: Ria
message: 「I think Japanese sweets are delicious too, though……」

name: Sally
message: 「They're called sweets? They really are super tasty!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heh-heh-heh. And so, you too should join the Sweets Appreciation Club----」

name: Sally
message: 「Aah, this is just as delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「……J-Just as delicious?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah! Sweet and yummy! What's this, what's this?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just as delicious……」

name: Ria
message: 「That's called a chocolate bar」

name: Synn
message: 「Why is Nanaka so shocked? They're both delicious」

name: Synn
message: 「What's with that pitying look, like you're staring at a guy who can't tell the difference?」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen. When someone says something four times cheaper tastes just as good, from the perspective of the person who bought them, well」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Expecting Mr. Tagalong to know the difference is a waste of effort, you know」

name: Ria
message: 「You shouldn't be sneakily reaching for your fourth one while saying that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sleeping children grow up big and strong, you know!」

name: Sally
message: 「This one's amazing too! Sweet and delicious! Humans are weaklings, sure, but the Human World is amazing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Amazing…… you say……」

name: Ria
message: 「That one is a strawberry candy」

name: Sally
message: 「Mmm, delicious! Ow, when I chew it, it sticks to my teeth and feels weird」

name: Ria
message: 「You're not supposed to chew candy. You lick it」

name: Misa
message: 「Candy... isn't the price difference way more than four times?」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa, this is delicious too! So sweet and tasty!」

name: Misa
message: 「She's nibbling on a sugar cube... I wonder if Nanaka-san can recover from this...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, that's just how it is in Omake-san's homeland」

name: Misa
message: 「The Demon World sure is impoverished...」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, she's already reaching for my slice of cake before I even noticed!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't get so mad, Hiss. An angel's homeland is impoverished too, you know」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I am not an angel! I'm merely as adorable as one!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Over a mere sugar cube...」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you trembling like that, Nanaka? Do you have a fever or something?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, the gap between when you're dense and when you're perceptive is way too huge」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, you little demon girl! Don't you dare put a mere sugar cube in the same league as sweets!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't understand the value of things at all! Not at all, completely clueless! You'll never survive in modern society like that!」

name: Sally
message: 「Eek! Why, why am I getting yelled at!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's got a calcium deficiency」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Calcium is found in high amounts in milk, eggshells, and the like」

name: Synn
message: 「When Sasami lays an egg, I'll give the shell to Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wrong! It's not a calcium deficiency!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You know, sugar cubes actually are pretty tasty though~」

name: Sally
message: 「Uh-huh, yum-yum」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I used to lick them a lot when I was a kid too~」

name: Ria
message: 「Me too~」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister as a little girl, innocently licking a sugar cube... Oh, how utterly adorable!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, Satchin, when did you sneak in here?! And you're eating sugar cubes too!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, I smelled sweets. Call me the shining example of a Sweets Club member~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're taking the Way of Sweets way too lightly!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Waaah, Nana-chan got mad~ You need more calcium~\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, everyone, you do know we're in the middle of Student Council activities right now, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, is that so! Before I knew it, I thought this had turned into an event for feeding sweets to Miss Extra. That's a real eye-opener.」

name: Ria
message: 「O-Of course I knew that.」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's right. Don't look as if you're the only one who knows.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Education!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no choice but to educate!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh. Nanaka's actually saying something sensible.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm always sensible!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's already too late to educate Sakura-kun at this point.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sally-chan! I'm gonna drill into you what sweets are all about!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ehh, sounds like a pain, so no.」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll let you stuff yourself full of sweets.」

name: Sally
message: 「Then drill it into me!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Look, everyone, let's do Student Council work, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's right! We've gotta do Student Council work \{too|\s12}!」
『Too,' huh...
